verdict.rationale: Typesense's ranking-and-relevance guide has dedicated sections on ranking by relevance plus popularity and by relevance plus recency, on boosting and burying sets of records, and on merchandising (promoting or hiding results), with a curation API alongside. A community comment confirms you can precompute a custom relevancy score in a sorting field that combines with text relevance, so business signals beyond textual matching are clearly supported. Missing for 10: explicit evidence for margin-style signals, detail beyond section headings on how the ranking rules are configured, and hands-on corroboration of tuning in practice.
